description: Validate a JavaScript PCB placement DSL file against the current linked schematic. Open the target PCB first, as for make_pcb_layout; the tool reads schematic connectivity, suggested schematic groups, board outline and component positions from EasyEDA automatically. Return backend error/warning/info diagnostics with English messages and optional component/source context; grouping differences are info only. No AutoPlace or placement is applied. For guidance, read /scratch/pkg/node_modules/easyeda-copilot-mcp/docs/pcb-layout/intent-validation.md.

file.description: Path to a JavaScript PCB layout DSL code file, as for make_pcb_layout.

name: validate_pcb_dsl
title: Validate PCB DSL
